Questions run 1-39 unbroken. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms pages 2-9, every page footed SET-31/5/3, header PAPER CODE 31/5/3) for a bare OR and confirming each on the paper: Q12 (A/B), Q15 (c) OR (c), Q16 (A/B), Q27 (A/B), Q28 (c) OR (c), Q29 (A/B), Q34 (A/B), Q38 (c) OR (c), Q39 (A/B) = 9 alternatives. Q13, Q14, Q35, Q36 and Q37 print parts with no OR and stay one row each. MCQ keys are CBSE's own, read off the scheme as images (20 keyed MCQs: Q1-9, Q17-24, Q30-32; Q8, Q9, Q24 and Q32 are assertion-reason); no void, grace or dual key anywhere in the scheme. Case-study sub-part marks are taken from the scheme (Q15, Q28, Q38 all 1 + 1 + 2). Sibling of 31/5/1: rows identical to it on this paper reuse its stem, context, options, answer, chapter, subtopic and difficulty byte for byte; Q16's two alternatives are printed in the opposite order from 31/5/1 (sugarcane is (A) here).
